results.note: hrad.cz could not be read (Cloudflare challenge); searches of hrad.cz, ČT24, iROZHLAS and ČTK and the ČT24 and ČTK front pages of 24 Oct show no published list of 2026 honours recipients by the deadline.

The Kremlin news page has no item dated 24 October (latest 23 October, none naming a date for talks), and a news search found no Kremlin, White House or Ukrainian presidency statement naming a calendar date; Zelensky spoke on 21 Oct only of hoping for talks by early November.

The ministry site was not checked; the Interior Ministry's nationwide count of 410,000 for 24 October (reported by ICI/France Bleu and Politique Matin on 24–25 Oct) is below its 550,000 for 17 October.

volby.statistics.sk could not be fetched; TASR (25 Oct 15:13) reports regional-election turnout of 46.56% from the State Commission with ŠÚ SR regional figures, above 43.74%, and SME's turnout page reports the same count.

Datafolha's site was not checked; Diário do Grande ABC (24 Oct 18:50 BRT) reports the Datafolha poll with fieldwork 23–24 October (4,050 interviews) giving Flávio Bolsonaro 51% and Lula 49% of valid votes.

elections.bc.ca was not fetched directly; BC Ballot's mirror of Elections BC preliminary results (25 Oct 17:04 PT) shows Conservatives leading in 63 of 93 districts, NDP 28, Greens 2, and CTV reports a Conservative majority.
AP (Colvin and Boak, 24 Oct) reports Trump spoke in person at the campaign rally in Perry, Georgia, on Saturday 24 October, announcing an Audi plant.

en.mfa.ir could not be fetched; AP (25 Oct) reports Baghaei only saying messages still pass via intermediaries, and Press TV (24 Oct) reports Iran presented no new proposals to the Pakistani mediator, so no on-record statement of a delivered response by 24 Oct.
The festival's winners page names Clio Barnard's 'I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning' as Best Film in the Progressive Cinema competition, announced 24 October.

RIK site was unreachable (permission not granted); Al Jazeera, citing RIK preliminary results, has the Student List on 52.54% vs the SNS-led United Serbia on 39.29%, and BIRN (balkaninsight.com, CRTA figures 51.5% vs 40.2%, Vucic conceded) agrees, so the SNS list did not come first.

cik.bg was not read directly; BNR (26 Oct 09:35) and Novinite (26 Oct 18:24) report CIK figures at 100% of protocols of Iotova–Valchev 34.76% and Gyurov–Kandev 31.95%, so no one was elected and a runoff on 1 November is required (AP also reports the runoff).
